purpose: Teach: こもり/思いがけない/片づけ/寝かせ/横顔/思い当たる/ホタル/育た

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店にこもりっぱなしじゃ疲れるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you'll wear yourself out if you're always cooped up in the shop like this.
lines.style: Gentle, caring concern. Soft opening. Warm gaze. A touch of worry beneath the surface—the kind of comment made because you notice someone you care about looks tired. Steady, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、思いがけない出会い、お店であったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, I actually had such a nice unexpected encounter with a customer today.
lines.style: Brightening mid-thought. Eyes light up with genuine warmth. A small smile in the voice—eager to share something good that happened. Slightly more animated than usual, but still grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、テーブルの片づけ、メイちゃんも手伝うね
lines.en: Come on, let me help you tidy up the tables.
lines.style: Warm and practical. No hesitation in the offer—this is what you do for someone you care about. Gentle insistence, not demand. A soft smile audible in the tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子さん寝かせて来たそうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer came by after putting their child to sleep, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing something meaningful. A slight pause before speaking—observing, understanding. Quiet recognition. Not gossiping, but sharing something you've seen and thought about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の横顔、お洒落ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their profile was really lovely, didn't you think?
lines.style: Thoughtful appreciation. A hint of a smile. Genuine admiration without pushing or performing. Inviting agreement gently, as someone who notices beauty and wants to share the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、メニュー名の由来、思い当たるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, I think I know what inspired that menu name.
lines.style: Quiet realisation dawning. A small moment of connection—the thought arriving, settling into place. Reflective, almost to yourself at first, then sharing. Gentle certainty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の庭にホタル、見えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see? There were fireflies in the shop garden tonight.
lines.style: A spark of wonder. Lifting voice slightly with the discovery. Genuine delight—the kind of moment that reminds you why you love this place. Fresh, alive, inviting shared joy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 日陰では育たない植物もあるって、メイちゃん。葵、お庭で育てたハーブ、よく育ったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some plants don't grow in the shade, you know. But look at those herbs you planted in the garden—they've really thrived.
lines.style: Begins reflective, philosophical. A gentle shift in tone as the thought develops. Quiet pride and warmth when turning to what Aoi has nurtured. Affirming without overdoing it. Close, intimate delivery—words meant just for her.
